title: Machine learning prioritizes SMS as a prognostic gene in hepatocellular carcinoma
summary: TCGA-LIHC, GSE14520 and single-cell data (GSE242889) were screened with univariate Cox, LASSO-Cox and random survival forest analyses, prioritizing spermine synthase (SMS), validated in GSE14520. In an independent cohort of 144 HCC patients after curative resection, high SMS expression by immunohistochemistry was associated with multiple tumors, microvascular invasion, BCLC stage B/C and shorter recurrence-free and overall survival, independently in multivariable Cox analyses. A clinical+SMS model discriminated better than SMS alone, but its improvement over the clinical model was not statistically significant. The cohort is single-center and machine learning served as a screening step.
